operator_constraint: MacBook only; no physical Windows machine

web_terminal.reason: smoke_broker_identity requires MetaTrader5 Python IPC to terminal64

recommended_macbook_only_path: Create Windows 11 ARM/x64 VM in UTM on this MacBook
Install Exness MT5 + Python 3.12 + pip install MetaTrader5
Clone/copy repo into VM; set XAUUSD_MT5_* env; run ./scripts/ops/foundation_live_gate.sh
Copy docs/ops/<date>-exness-smoke.json with ok:true back to Mac repo
note: Do not invent PASS. Mac-native Wine MetaQuotes Demo cannot close Gate C.
